title: Canonical tensor stage diagrams
statement: Let I be a directed preorder and F:I→CommRingCat a ring diagram. Fix i₀≤i, commutative F(i₀)-algebras B₀,C₀, commutative rings P,Q with Q a P-algebra, and a P-algebra structure on B_i=F(i)⊗_{F(i₀)}B₀. On J={j | i≤j}, there exist P-algebra structures on B_j=F(j)⊗_{F(i₀)}B₀, common-universe ring diagrams D,E, and ring equivalences d_j:D_j≃B_j⊗_P Q, c_j:E_j≃C_j=F(j)⊗_{F(i₀)}C₀. There are P-algebra maps βs_j:B_i→B_j whose underlying maps are the canonical tensor transitions. Every D-transition corresponds under d to β_jk⊗id_Q for a P-linear canonical tensor transition β_jk; every E-transition corresponds under c to the canonical tensor transition. No comparison map is needed or produced.

source.place: Tags 02JO (lemma-flat-finite-presentation-limit-flat), proof of (3), construction of Ψ; 00DD (lemma-tensor-product-colimit), canonical tensor legs. Online source read 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Write t_ij for the F(i₀)-algebra transition F(i)→F(j), and let b_ij=t_ij⊗id_B₀. Give B_j its P-action via the actual ring map b_ij composed with the algebra map P→B_i. Functoriality gives b_jk composed with b_ij=b_ik, so every canonical transition is P-linear. Take D_j=ULift(B_j⊗_P Q), E_j=ULift(C_j), and define their maps by RingHom.ulift of β_jk⊗id_Q and t_jk⊗id_C₀. Tensor map identity and composition laws prove both functor laws. Take d_j and c_j to be ULift.ringEquiv and βs_j to be b_ij with its induced P-linearity. All asserted conjugation identities follow directly from these definitions. This construction also works for singleton or nonskeletal preorders and for zero rings.

proof_origin.place: Explicit formal elaboration of step 1 of the parent finite-stage tensor construction, using the cited tensor universal properties.

theorem exists_comparison_tensor_stage_diagrams
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v})
    (i₀ : I) (B₀ : Type w) (C₀ : Type x) [CommRing B₀] [CommRing C₀]
    [Algebra (F.obj i₀) B₀] [Algebra (F.obj i₀) C₀]
    (P Q : Type y) [CommRing P] [CommRing Q] [Algebra P Q]
    (i : I) (hi : i₀ ≤ i)
    (aPi : let := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)) :
      let J := {j : I // i ≤ j}
      ∃ (aPs : ∀ j : J,
          let := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
          Algebra P (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
        ∃ (D E : J ⥤ CommRingCat.{max v w x y}),
          ∃ (d : ∀ j : J,
              let := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
              let := aPs j
              ↥(D.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q),
            ∃ (c : ∀ j : J,
                let := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                ↥(E.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀)),
                  ∃ (βs : ∀ j : J,
                    let := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
                    let := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let := aPi
                    let := aPs j
                    (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
                      (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
                  (∀ j : J,
                    let := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
                    let := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let αij : F.obj i →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj j.val :=
                      { (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom with
                        commutes' := fun s ↦
                          congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj j.val ↦ f s)
                            (F.map_comp (homOfLE hi) (homOfLE j.property)).symm }
                    (βs j).toRingHom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αij (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom) ∧
                  (∀ {j k : J} (r : j ⟶ k),
                    let := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans k.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let := aPs j
                    let := aPs k
                    ∃ β : (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
                        (↥(F.obj k.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀),
                      (let αjk : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj k.val :=
                        { (F.map (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).hom with
                          commutes' := fun s ↦
                            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj k.val ↦ f s)
                              (F.map_comp (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))
                                (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).symm };
                        β.toRingHom =
                          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αjk
                            (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom) ∧
                      (d k).toRingHom.comp (D.map r).hom =
                        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map β (AlgHom.id P Q)).toRingHom.comp
                          (d j).toRingHom) ∧
                  (∀ {j k : J} (r : j ⟶ k),
                    let := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans k.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let αjk : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj k.val :=
                        { (F.map (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).hom with
                          commutes' := fun s ↦
                            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj k.val ↦ f s)
                              (F.map_comp (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))
                                (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).symm }
                    (c k).toRingHom.comp (E.map r).hom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αjk (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) C₀)).toRingHom.comp
                        (c j).toRingHom)
